row: Love Steeds - LS Equine Therapy & Education

LS Equine Therapy has a big dream to educate & share great therapy techniques & ideas that improve the well being & health of horses all over the world. 

The mission is to help horses feel and move their best & to educate by empowering equestrians with knowledge & skills to improve the mental & physical well being of their equines themselves, rather than always relying on "the equine professionals". Disclaimer: this does not replace veterinary care or the skilled work of professional equine therapists.

Ilse Kemp is the founder of LS Equine Therapy. Her ex race horse Dushybeag was her muse at the beginning. She now has a broad client base ranging from shetland ponies to racehorses. 

A life-long student of the horse and advocate for horse, Ilse wholeheartedly wants to inspire other equestrians to be more mindful and help their wonderful steeds. WE MUST REMEMBER horses want to please & innocently give their best, tolerating discomfort until it cannot be tolerated anymore.
